draft.presenting_complaints: 71‑year‑old male with orthopnoea, paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnoea and bilateral pedal oedema for 1 week.
hospital_course: Admitted 20/09/2026 with acute decompensated heart failure (ADHF) and started IV furosemide 40 mg BD.
Baseline labs on 20/09/2026: NT‑proBNP 6800 pg/mL (↑), 2D echo LVEF 30 % (↓).
Continued diuresis with furosemide IV and oral spironolactone 25 mg OD, bisoprolol 2.5 mg OD.
By 23/09/2026, net negative fluid balance 3.2 L, breathing improved, diuresis continued.
No invasive procedures performed during stay.
